params.name: topic
params.label: Webhook Path
params.help: Derived from the workflow topic and exposed at /wh/<topic>.

params.name: group_id
params.label: Access Group
params.help: Optional tbl.groups access gate for protected workflow execution.

params.name: topic
params.label: Kafka Topic
params.help: Inbound Kafka topic that should execute this workflow.

params.name: consumer_group
params.label: Consumer Group
params.help: Optional Kafka consumer group. Empty uses a group of its own (wf-<database>-<trigger id>).

params.name: use_dedupe
params.label: Use Dedupe
params.help: Deprecated and ignored: each offset runs once because the run is named after it. Set dedupe_key on the trigger to deduplicate by a payload field.

params.name: topic
params.label: MQTT Topic
params.help: MQTT topic or wildcard pattern that should execute this workflow.

params.name: qos
params.label: QoS
params.help: MQTT delivery quality of service; fixed at 1 (at-least-once) for every subscription.

params.name: port
params.label: Port
params.help: Listen port for this trigger (one trigger per port). Must be inside the server's tcp.portMin-tcp.portMax range; requires tcp.useTcp.

params.name: framing
params.label: Framing
params.help: How one message is delimited on the stream. The body is passed to the workflow untouched.

params.name: len_includes_header
params.label: Length Includes Header
params.help: Set when the sender counts the length header bytes in the length value.

params.name: tls_mode
params.label: TLS
params.help: TLS and mutual TLS use the certificate files from the server config (tcp.tlsCertFile, tcp.tlsKeyFile, tcp.tlsClientCaFile).

params.name: reply_timeout_ms
params.label: Reply Timeout (ms)
params.help: Time the workflow has to produce the reply; on timeout the connection is closed without a reply.

params.name: model
params.label: Model
params.help: Runtime model to watch for create/write/unlink events. Options are sourced from GET /wf/sys-models.

params.name: trigger_domain
params.label: Trigger Domain
params.help: Optional domain condition that gates the whole workflow: evaluated on every create/write/unlink event for the selected model, independent of the Operation below. Leave empty to skip this gate.

params.name: operation
params.label: Operation
params.help: Record-lifecycle event that fires this workflow. "before_*" evaluates the domain against the pre-image (values before the write); "after_*" against the post-image (persisted record). Always fires after the write has committed — a model trigger can filter an event, never block it.

params.name: domain
params.label: Domain
params.help: Optional domain condition (same format as list-view filters) matched against the record snapshot for the selected Operation only. The workflow only runs when the domain matches — leave empty to fire on every occurrence of the selected operation.

params.name: authorization
params.label: Authorization
params.help: Select a sys.credential to send its access token as the Authorization header. Leave empty to send none.

params.name: model_name
params.label: Model Name
params.help: Optional source model. When selected, the frontend can fetch its JSON template from /wf/sys-models.

params.name: authorization
params.label: Authorization
params.help: Select a sys.credential to send its access token as the Authorization header. Leave empty to send none.
Shared secret as a @cred:<name> or @syscred:<name> reference.
params.label: HMAC Key
params.name: hmac_key

params.help: Dotted payload path of the received signature (for example signature or meta.sig).
params.label: Signature Field
params.name: signature_field

params.help: Dotted payload path of the signed message. Text is signed as is; any other value as compact JSON with sorted keys.
params.label: Message Field
params.name: message_field
expression
params.label: Condition
params.help: JSON condition object evaluated against the current payload. Leaf operators: exists, empty, equals, not_equals, in, not_in, gt, gte, lt, lte (numbers only), contains (substring or array element), regex (RE2, max 512 chars); combine with all/any/not. Example: {"field":"amount","gte":100}

params.name: automation_action_id
params.label: Custom Action
params.help: Lua custom action (Automation > Actions) to run. It sees payload (previous node output), data (the JSON below), raw, topic, step_key and base.

params.name: data
params.label: Custom Data
params.help: Optional JSON object handed to the script as the global "data", e.g. {"threshold": 10}.
Published workflow to run as a sub-workflow. It runs its published version in this database under the same identity.
params.label: Target Workflow
params.name: target_workflow_id

params.help: sync = wait for the child run and use its output (the only mode for now).
params.label: Wait
params.name: wait

params.help: pass_through = the child receives the current payload as is.
params.label: Payload Mapping
params.name: payload_mapping

params.help: Dotted payload path of the array to iterate (for example order.lines). An object element is the child payload as is; any other element is sent as {"item": value}.
params.label: Items Path
params.name: items_path

params.help: Published workflow to run as a sub-workflow. It runs its published version in this database under the same identity.
params.label: Target Workflow
params.name: target_workflow_id

params.help: Children running at once (1 to 8).
params.label: Max Concurrency
params.name: max_concurrency

params.help: The step fails without retries when the array is longer (at most 1000).
params.label: Max Items
params.name: max_items

params.help: On: the first failed item stops the others and fails the step. Off: every item runs and failures are collected as {"_error": ...} entries.
params.label: Fail Fast
params.name: fail_fast

params.help: Payload key that receives the array of child outputs.
params.label: Output Field
params.name: output_field

params.help: The wait fails the run after this many seconds without a decision (0 = never; at most 30 days).
params.label: Expires In Seconds
params.name: expires_in_seconds

params.help: Optional. Members of this group who hold the workflow operator role may approve or reject the waiting run without its resume token. The user who started the run still cannot approve it.
